headline: Weave no longer trades: its buyout closed today, and the 8-K is the closing paperwork
reasoning: Source: Weave Communications' 8-K filed 16:40 ET, items 1.01, 2.01, 5.02, 8.01. Quoted: 'On the Closing Date, Parent completed the acquisition of the Company through the Merger.' It also covers the new owner's $190M term loan from Hercules Capital, repayment of the old credit line and the end of the Engine Capital cooperation agreement.
What changed: each share has been converted into the merger consideration and the stock will be delisted. The deal was priced when it was announced.
objections: A completed take-private; there is no stock left to trade.
